pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with rounded vertices. Patch size is largest on the mid-flank and decreases significantly toward the hindquarters and lower leg, where they become more fragmented and densely packed. Edge gradients are soft, indicating fur texture at current resolution.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological web. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate or quadri-radiate. Pathway thickness is relatively wide on the upper flank and narrows into a fine mesh between smaller patches on the lower limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a dark, low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The jagged profile is continuous from the upper neck through the shoulder transition.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: No intrinsic structural breaks or discontinuities are visible in the mane, although the silhouette is partially obscured by a dark avian hitchhiker on the dorsal neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-toned bird (likely an oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge of the neck, creating a localized silhouette anomaly and partially occluding the mane.
